critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~925 lines — consider splitting into routers/{auth,events,posts,faqs,media,bookings,settings}.py for maintainability
BookingModal opens WhatsApp via window.open which may be blocked by popup blockers on some browsers; consider fallback anchor with target=_blank

Floorplan table hotspots have fixed % positions — will drift on very small/mobile viewports; hotspot centering uses translate(-50%,-50%) which is fine, but consider clamp() on size (already used) and test on 390px viewport
